offering_description.value: Builds and paves roads, highways and bridges, and produces its own asphalt and aggregates. Sells mainly to state transportation agencies, counties and cities through public bid contracts.

primary_services.value: highway paving; road and bridge construction; site preparation

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, counties, cities; B2B: private developers and commercial site owners

end_markets.value: transportation infrastructure; public works; commercial and residential development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: road and bridge construction contracts won through public bidding; product sales: asphalt, aggregates and concrete sold to contractors and project owners

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs road and bridge construction for public and private owners; OEM / manufacturer: produces asphalt, aggregates and concrete from its own plants and quarries; asset operator: owns and runs asphalt plants and aggregate quarries
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern states such as Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee

specialization.value: related lines: paving, road and bridge construction, asphalt, aggregates and concrete

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and contracts sold directly to public agencies and private owners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, worker safety and transport rules, and state highway construction specifications

notes: States served and the exact mix of public and private work are from general knowledge and may have changed.
